title: HHHusher FAQ
description: Questions on cream in two halves. Left, a big numbered list of question groups (the chosen one at full strength, the others at 15%) that stays in view while you scroll; right, the chosen group's questions between thin rules, each with a 40px outlined square plus button that fills dark on hover and opens the answer with a smooth height change. Phones stack the group list on top.
notes: switching groups and opening answers need JavaScript (hydrate: visible)
